title: II. Four classes of ceremonial precepts; sacrifices divided
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): By sacred things stand as meant sacred persons and all else required for external worship. Legal observances stood as ceremonies belonging toward pacification and sanctification by which they stood as distinguished from unbelievers. — A sacrifice stands as an external sacred action by which some sensible, permanent thing stands as offered immediately toward God by a lawful minister, toward testify His supreme dominion and ye human's subjection. Sacrifices stand as divided four ways: by matter, by form, by bloody or unbloody offering, and by particular end (latreutic, eucharistic, petitionary, or propitiatory). — II. Its precepts, however varied, may chiefly be referred toward four classes: sacraments, sacrifices, sacred things, and legal observances. Of ye sacraments we will speak below in their place.
pass_b_english: II. Its precepts, however varied, may chiefly be referred to four classes: sacraments, sacrifices, sacred things, and legal observances. Of the sacraments we will speak below in their place.

A sacrifice is an external sacred action by which some sensible, permanent thing is offered immediately to God by a lawful minister, to testify His supreme dominion and the human's subjection. Sacrifices are divided four ways: by matter, by form, by bloody or unbloody offering, and by particular end (latreutic, eucharistic, petitionary, or propitiatory).

By sacred things are meant sacred persons and all else required for external worship. Legal observances were ceremonies of pacification and sanctification by which they were distinguished from unbelievers.
source_text: II. Ejus praecepta, quantumvis varia, tamen ad quatuor classes potissimum referri possunt: sacramenta, sacrificia, sacra, & legales observationes. De sacramentis inferius suo loco dicetur. Sacrificium vero est externa sacra actio, qua res aliqua sensibilis, permanens, a legitimo ministro Deo proxime offertur, ad testificandum supremum illius dominium & hominis subjectionem. Dividi autem possunt sacrificia quadriariam: 1. ratione materiae (animal / inanimis; holocaustum, immolatio, libamen); 2. ex forma (holocaustum, hostia pacifica, hostia pro peccato); 3. ex parte rei oblatae (cruentum / incruentum); 4. ex fine (latreuticum, eucharisticum, impetratorium, hilasticum). Per sacra intelliguntur personae sacrae, loca, tempus, vasa, instrumenta cultus. Observationes legales erant ceremoniae ad pacificationem & sanctificationem pertinentes, quibus ab infidelibus discernebantur.
